name: Parasol Whitetop
desc: Parasol Whitetop (Doellingeria umbellata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Doellingeria umbellata, known by the common names tall flat-topped white aster, parasol whitetop, or tall white-aster, is a North American plant species in the family Asteraceae.
